sql.closerDashboard.getIronmanFdcCounts: WITH "quarters" AS ( select (extract('year' from now()) || '-01-01')::date as "q1_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-03-31')::date as "q1_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-04-01')::date as "q2_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-06-30')::date as "q2_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-07-01')::date as "q3_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-09-30')::date as "q3_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-10-01')::date as "q4_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-12-31')::date as "q4_end" ) SELECT (select coalesce(sum(q1points), 0) from (select count(1) * case when greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between ('2020-01-01') and ('2020-01-31') and pd.source in (6, 8, 484) then 1.5 when greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between ('2020-03-01') and ('2020-03-31') and pd.source in (8, 484) then 2 else 1 end as q1points from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user u on u.id = pd.closer_user_id where pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q1_start from quarters) and (select q1_end from quarters) else greatest(pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q1_start from quarters) and (select q1_end from quarters) end and ((pd.cancelled_date is null) or (pd.cancelled_date is not null and pd.cancelled_date::date > (select q1_end from quarters))) and (p.company_project_status_type_id is null or p.company_project_status_type_id != 3) and u.id = :currentUserId group by pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date, pd.final_design_signed_date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date, pd.source) t ) as "q1", (select count(1) from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user u on u.id = pd.closer_user_id where pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q2_start from quarters) and (select q2_end from quarters) else greatest(pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q2_start from quarters) and (select q2_end from quarters) end and ((pd.cancelled_date is null) or (pd.cancelled_date is not null and pd.cancelled_date::date > (select q2_end from quarters))) and (p.company_project_status_type_id is null or p.company_project_status_type_id != 3) and u.id = :currentUserId ) as "q2", (select count(1) from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user u on u.id = pd.closer_user_id where pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q3_start from quarters) and (select q3_end from quarters) = pd.closer_user_id where pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not sql.closerDashboard.getCloserTableScores: SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as name, cust.user_status_type, o.org_name as officeName, o2.org_name as region, coalesce(metro_area.metro_area, '--') as metroArea, count(case when pd.closer_appointment_start::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source not in (6, 8, 484) and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (p.company_project_status_type_id is null or p.company_project_status_type_id != 3) then 1 end) as leadGenFdcPercentageNumerator, count(case when pd.closer_appointment_start::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source not in (6, 8, 484) then 1 end) as leadGenFdcPercentageDenominator, count(case when greatest(pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date, pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source not in (6, 8, 484) and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (p.company_project_status_type_id is null or p.company_project_status_type_id != 3) then 1 end) as selfGenFdc, count(case when greatest(pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date, pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 5 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (p.company_project_status_type_id is null or p.company_project_status_type_id != 3) then 1 end) as totalFdc FROM flow.project p INNER JOIN flow.contact c ON c.id = p.contact_id INNER JOIN brs.project_details pd ON pd.project_id = p.id INNER JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = pd.closer_user_id INNER JOIN flow.user_position upos ON upos.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_status_type ust ON ust.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.company_user_status_type cust ON cust.id = ust.company_user_status_type_id INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = upos.org_id INNER JOIN flow.org o2 ON (o2.id = o.parent_org_id and o2.org_type_id = 2) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(5, 185, p.id, 0, false) as metro_area) metro_area ON TRUE WHERE CASE WHEN :officeRanking IS TRUE THEN -- Office Ranking (1st row of tables) upos.org_id IN (select distinct org_id from flow.user_position where user_id = :currentUserId and archived is false and primary_flag is true) ELSE -- Company Ranking (2nd row of tables) upos.position_id = 1 AND upos.archived IS FALSE AND upos.end_date IS NULL AND o.active_flag IS TRUE AND o2.active_flag IS TRUE END AND cust.user_status_type = 'Active' GROUP BY u.id, officeName, region, metro_area.metro_area, cust.user_status_type
